name: extractEmails
requirements: Identify and extract all email addresses from a provided string
Return an array of unique email addresses
Convert all extracted emails to lowercase for consistency
Validate that the input is a string
Handle multiple occurrences and various TLD lengths
edge_cases: Input is null, undefined, or not a string
String contains no emails (should return empty array)
Duplicate emails in the same string
Emails with special characters like '+' or '.' in the local part
